title: Cocontinuous and special cocontinuous functors between sites
statement: Let $\mathcal C$, $\mathcal D$ be sites with coverings and continuous functors as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ a functor. (1) $u$ is *cocontinuous* if for every $U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ and every covering $\{V_j\to u(U)\}_{j\in J}$ of $\mathcal D$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ of $\mathcal C$ such that the family $\{u(U_i)\to u(U)\}_{i\in I}$ refines $\{V_j\to u(U)\}_{j\in J}$, i.e. every $u(U_i)\to u(U)$ factors through some $V_j\to u(U)$ (Stacks Sites, Definition 00XJ). (2) $u$ is *special cocontinuous* if (a) $u$ is cocontinuous; (b) $u$ is continuous [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]; (c) for $a,b:U'\to U$ in $\mathcal C$ with $u(a)=u(b)$ there is a covering $\{f_i:U'_i\to U'\}$ of $\mathcal C$ with $a\circ f_i=b\circ f_i$ for all $i$; (d) for $U',U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ and a morphism $c:u(U')\to u(U)$ of $\mathcal D$ there are a covering $\{f_i:U'_i\to U'\}$ of $\mathcal C$ and morphisms $c_i:U'_i\to U$ with $u(c_i)=c\circ u(f_i)$; (e) every $V\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal D)$ has a covering in $\mathcal D$ of the form $\{u(U_i)\to V\}_{i\in I}$. These are conditions (1)-(5) of Stacks Sites, Lemma 03A0 (label lemma-equivalence); Stacks' Definition 03CG (label definition-special-cocontinuous-functor) calls $u$ special cocontinuous when it satisfies the assumptions and the conclusion of Lemma 03A0, and since that lemma derives the conclusion (the morphism of topoi $g:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ of the cocontinuous $u$, Stacks Sites Lemma 00XO, is an equivalence) from (1)-(5), the two definitions agree; here the conclusion is not part of the definition and is proved where it is needed.
